paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Stellar cooling bound from the R2 parameter (AGB/HB star ratio) in globular clusters using MESA simulations. Conservative constraint (semiconvection scheme): g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1; asteroseismology-favoured predictive mixing would give 0.34e-10 GeV^-1 (not emitted, as authors do not adopt it as their final constraint). Bound is mass-independent for thermally produced axions (m_a below a few keV); encoded as a flat line over the paper's Fig. 1 mass range 1e-8 to 10 eV. Astrophysical bound, so no local DM density assumption. Derived from observed 95% confidence limits on R2. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
